name: XCC_BALANCE_ACTIVITIES
description: This tables reflects how transactions affect the budgetary control balances.

columns.name: HEADER_NUM
columns.description: Unique identifier for this transaction.

columns.name: PENDING_HEADER_GROUP_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservation amount for earlier transactions with same header group in current budgetary control request for this control budget, account, and period at time of funds reservation.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Internal line number for budgetary control engine processing

columns.name: BALANCE_LINE_ORDER
columns.description: Balance line number, it is part of the primary key.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the impacted Control Budget for this balance activity entry.

columns.name: CONTROL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: The control level code indicates how the entry is treated, it is either ABSOLUTE, ADVISORY, TRACKING or NONE.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tolerance used in funds checking expressed by an amount.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Tolerance used in funds checking expressed by a percentage.

columns.name: ENTERED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount entered on the transaction line.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY
columns.description: Represents the transaction currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Conversion type used to obtain the budget currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used to calculate the amount in  budget currency.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount expressed in budget currency.

columns.name: BUDGET_DATE
columns.description: Date used to perform the budget checking.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Budget period in which falls the budget checking.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Key flexfield combination defining column that indentifies the budget account

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds check or reservation for this particular balance activity

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Activity type can be Original, Liquidation, Rounding Plug or Backout.

columns.name: ALLOC_HEADER_NUM
columns.description: For liquidations, it identifies the original header.

columns.name: ALLOC_LINE_NUM
columns.description: For liquidations, it identifies the original line number.

columns.name: BACKOUT_HEADER_NUM
columns.description: For backouts, it identifies the backed out header.

columns.name: BACKOUT_LINE_NUM
columns.description: For backouts, it corresponds to the backed out line number.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifes the type of balance, it can be Obligation, Commitment, Other, Actual or Budget.

columns.name: SUB_BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: This code represents the detail balance type.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Initial amount budgeted to this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.  Add the budget adjustment amount to get the total budget.

columns.name: BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount by which the budgeted amount had been increased or decreased for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds committed for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds obligated for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds in the bucket called other, for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds spent for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAILABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total funds available for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: PENDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservations for earlier transactions for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: OTHER_LINES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservations for earlier lines in this transaction for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: NET_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tolerance allowed at the time of funds reservation.  It does not indicate what has been used, just records what was allowed.

columns.name: PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Project Management expenditure type identifier. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: PJC_TOP_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Project Management top resource identifier being burdened against. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: PJC_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Project Management lowest resource identifier being burdened against. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account impacted by this activity. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: LEDGER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in the primary ledger's currency. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: BURDEN_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: A Yes or No flag indicating whether this line is a burdening line.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_CLOSED_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an activity has closed period override considered.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_FUNDS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an activity has insufficient funds override considered.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated tolerance amount needed for funds reservation.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated override amount needed for funds reservation.

columns.name: PERIOD_CHANGE_FOR_UNDO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the data is reversed into a different period.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FOR_ESSBASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that balances have been transferred to the budget cube for this control budget and period name combination.Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: BALANCES_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether control budget balance is impacted. Valid values are Y, N and NULL.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
